call_mcp_tool: call an MCP tool by server name and tool name with arguments and optional user authentication
list_all_mcp_tools: list all available tools across all configured MCP servers with optional user authentication
load_mcp_servers_from_config: load MCP server configurations from a dictionary and register them in the server manager
health_check_mcp_server: perform a health check on a specific MCP server by server ID and return its status
get_allowed_mcp_servers: get the list of MCP server IDs allowed for a given user API key with access control
